scope: Saved incorporation pathway and submission approval/dependency gates
fixes: Explicit annual-ledger sourceFilingId links derive current detailed status/date and fail safely on missing, mismatched or foreign sources; no automatic verification or inferred annual period.
Identical jurisdiction/year retries reuse the row; conflicting new-save payloads and duplicate explicit edits reject atomically.
Create/update/mark-filed/direct registry import/staged section import/private bot patches enforce common filed date/method/evidence facts; effective existing evidence is reauthorized.
Invalid later staged imports roll back prior filing/source-document writes; repeated corrected imports do not duplicate records.
Unimplemented preview nodes are skipped/manual-required and cannot appear as executed; workflow launch respects active state and local-mode boundary.

n8n callback credentials go only to exact operator-configured recipe endpoints; secret-bearing POST redirects are disabled, current authority is checked immediately before egress, raw responses/errors are not stored.
Unfinished external workflows reject duplicate launches; late acknowledgements/step updates/failures cannot overwrite terminal callbacks.

Generated-PDF preflight/record/callback require current bound actor, tasks/documents write authority, enabled workflow module and active workflow; document/version/key/name references are pinned to the exact run.

PDF fingerprint and size bind one generated document/version; exact terminal callback fingerprint acknowledges retries, changed body rejects; gateway reuses stored files and removes unused concurrent candidates.

Callback notes/output reject credential fields/secret echoes/unsafe URL receipts and oversized structures before file or history writes; gateway PDF cap is 7 MiB within the existing 10 MiB JSON parser.

Generated local-file claims require the trusted platform service token in addition to the current bound actor and write permissions; new claims reject any already-used document-version storage key, including known foreign-tenant keys. Same-run pinned-file retries remain idempotent.

Generated-file downloads fail closed when historical local-provider claims for the same storage key span tenants. Nonlocal provider keys are outside that shared generated-file directory and do not block an authorized local record.

checks.evidence: Actual native Convex handlers and local client/backup: link/status reversal/deletion, role/tenant/service permissions, duplicate retries/conflicts, date/evidence ACL validation, direct/staged import atomicity and retries.

Three actual native n8n actions over isolated loopback HTTP; credential destination/redirect/response gates, unfinished-run duplicate launch, before-egress current authority, preview manual-required behavior.

Native completed-run zero writes; concurrent identical PDF one document/version; exact callback retries; digest/body/run-reference mismatch; terminal CAS and actor/workflow/module revocation. Missing/bad platform proof and known foreign storage-key collisions create zero documents/versions; foreign-byte download stays denied.

Actual mounted Express route with fixture transport/JWT issuer and real native handlers: wrong callback secret, completed-run zero files, concurrent/exact PDF retry one file/document/version, unsafe receipt/tamper/cap/current actor denial. Actual gateway forwards platform proof only after the file write and still retains one file/document/version for concurrent callbacks.

Registry/graph/input branches, frozen evidence, independent current review, manual/uploaded receipt/certificate gates, trusted adapter concurrent CAS, uncertain-outcome no automatic retry, readonly backup restore.

checks.command: npm run test:annual-filings && npm run test:filing-preparation-integration
checks.evidence: Annual calculations, real native/local BC packets, official manual handoffs, jurisdiction/type/form/charity/year/role/tenant and service-resource gates; deadline clamping.

Current authenticated actor/document ACL, verified issuer and platform proof required; same-key foreign local versions deny otherwise readable own versions, foreign nonlocal-provider controls retain legitimate local access.

ledger.mode: Fresh real local workspace via public guided setup; saved detailed filing, explicit link, validation error retaining modal, manual evidence, reload and duplicate-save containment.

pathway.mode: Real IndexedDB pathway transactions: frozen branch inputs, owned draft evidence, independent reviewer, official manual outbox handoff, reload persistence and viewport containment.

limits: No government/CRA submission, real message delivery or enterprise SSO was performed. Formal incorporation facts never derive from prepared/completed workflow steps or self-reported ledger status.
Native tests use Convex-test identity/transaction fixtures; mounted HTTP gateway uses explicit transport and JWT issuer adapters. Actual deployment/provider/SSO qualification remains separate.

Production n8n still requires reviewed operator recipe endpoints, callback configuration, provider deployment and credentials. Tenant-custom destinations cannot receive the shared callback credential.
A file write whose native commit/authority cannot be rechecked remains private for operator reconciliation; cleanup does not delete a possibly committed file.
Phone/tablet emulation does not establish physical-device, Safari/Firefox or signed-installer behavior.
